Indico Developments · Request for construction estimate

Katembe Ocean Views

A 5 storey residential building with 17 apartments (12 T3, 3 T2, 2 compact T2), a rooftop restaurant with terrace and mezzanine, a ground floor supermarket and social area, pool club, parking and landscaped site, facing Maputo Bay. Katembe, Maputo, Mozambique.

Book a callSend your estimateDrawings and documents
17apartments · 12 T3 · 3 T2 · 2 T2 compact
3,969 m²internal floor area (rooms)
6levels incl. restaurant and mezzanine
2,432 m²site area (model)

What we would like from you

  • A budget estimate to build the project: structure, masonry, roof, plaster and screeds, waterproofing, MEP installation, finishes installation and external works
  • Your proposed scope split (what you build, what you would subcontract, what you expect us to supply)
  • Construction programme in months, with the main phases
  • Validity of the estimate and payment terms
  • Or simply book a call with us first to go through the project

Everything you need is on this page: drawings, structure, services, interiors, 3D model and measured quantities. Questions are welcome on the call.

The project

Renders of the finished building and interiors.

Floor areas from the model:

  • First Floor: 855 m²
  • Second Floor: 855 m²
  • Third Floor: 855 m²
  • Ground Floor: 330 m²
  • Fourth Floor (Restaurant): 761 m²
  • Restaurant Mezzanine: 312 m²
